gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-montagu-slab: Outrun Future draws wide-spaced letters with a rope-like outline of constant width, giving the heading a synthwave, commanding presence. Montagu Slab keeps pages lively with sturdy downstrokes and slender turns.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-ovo: Authoritative from the first glance, Outrun Future holds every stroke to a constant width, tails and terminals as stout as stems. Ovo meets it with slightly thinned strokes, like type stamped in soft metal.
gen-dafont-ozone-fs-fira-sans: Technical and geometric, Ozone keeps stems and crossbars at one thickness, with capitals barely rising above the lowercase. Fira Sans lets its s curves open generously and its lowercase stand tall, so paragraphs glide along.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-fauna-one: Dignified and literary, with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders, the body text is the quiet half. Fauna One carries the paragraphs, while Ozone earns its keep big and short, every stroke one stylus wide.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-glegoo: Technical to the core, Ozone traces every stroke at a single pen width, capitals nearly level with lowercase. Glegoo has big counters and unclosed curves, so a moderate size lets them breathe.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-hanuman: Ozone draws as if with a fixed pen, wide-set curves throughout. Hanuman is the refined, traditional partner, its high-waisted lowercase and wide-set s terminals inviting a fairly generous size.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text leans literary, with big entrances into each curve. Ozone excels at a line width that never thickens or thins; Noticia Text excels at dignified lowercase filling most of the letter height.
gen-dafont-ozone-gf-pridi: Pridi stands proud, its small letters almost capital-sized, beside Ozone, which looks bent from one length of wire. Pridi offers refined, classic reading through generous space between curve ends and the stem.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-headland-one: Heavy and closed, Plakkaat sweeps its terminals nearly to the stem. Headland One loosens everything with well-spaced, gently varied letters and a tall round o, making that closed-against-open contrast the draw.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-hedvig-letters-se: Thick, closed, and loud: Plakkaat is all weight. Hedvig Letters Serif is its opposite, with open-ended curves, sturdy lowercase and medium contrast, and that closed-against-open tension is the hook.
